description: Verified landlord-tenant rules for one US state, checked against the official statutes: security deposit limit and return deadline, late-fee rules, landlord entry notice, notice to end a month-to-month tenancy, rent-increase notice, repairs, retaliation, and lease clauses that are commonly unenforceable. Each rule has a citation and source link.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. CA, NY, TX

name: tenant_law
title: US tenant law by state
